prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman walking alone with dark-brown hair in a messy bun and loose strands, fair natural complexion, minimal makeup, silver over-ear headphones, white collared shirt under a beige sweater vest and brown leather jacket, blue jeans, and casual sneakers. Hold a white takeaway coffee cup and small brown paper bag.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused overcast daylight with muted earthy browns, reds, grays, and natural skin tones, moderate background softness, cozy candid street mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, 28mm wide-angle, vertical 9:16, moderate depth of field, authentic handheld perspective, realistic leather and fabric texture.
